channel_surfaces.eligibility_note: Channel and audience settings apply; posts unavailable on Made-for-Kids channels and supervised accounts
Must subscribe for creator-chosen minimum period to contribute; moderation can apply

channel_surfaces.description: Posts available to eligible paid members
channel_surfaces.eligibility_note: Requires enabled and eligible channel membership program with appropriate levels

viewer_segments.definition: First-time viewing for selected channel period, including history-cleared, private-mode or long-inactive viewers
Watched the channel at least once per month for 1 to 5 months in past year
Watched the channel at least once per month for more than 6 months in past year

membership_register.definition: Includes canceled memberships still accessing perks until billing period ends
Total members minus canceled subscribers who retain access
Members signing up in the period
Member cancels even though access may remain through paid period
Previously canceled members whose paid period has ended
New sign-ups or recurring payments; not unique individuals
Creator's reported membership revenue for selected billing period, after applicable platform rules

cohort_protocol.target: Creator-owned channel with defined geographic audience and stable publishing format; compare consecutive eligible calendar cohorts and matched controls where lawful
cohort_protocol.study_unit: channel_by_observation_period; aggregate viewer and paying-member cohorts, no person-level collection
cohort_protocol.entry_event: Channel post publication, or first eligible appearance in viewer's channel watch series, declared before analysis
cohort_protocol.comparison: Matched non-post days/channels with similar uploads, content mix, recent impressions, baseline returning viewers and seasonal audience conditions
cohort_protocol.primary_response: Change in comparable estimated returning-viewer outcome over specified following window; no causal effect without research identification
cohort_protocol.unavailable_join: Public-data interface does not link post impression recipients to unique returned-video viewers or membership payers

billing.repeat_purchase_definition: Retention by unique original purchaser cohort needs distinct billing identity and renewal events across eligible cycles; payment event counts alone are insufficient
billing.privacy_rule: Never publish member identifiers or exports in public repository

inference_safeguards: Post impressions and likes are events, not independently matched human channel viewers.
New, casual and regular viewers are channel watch-behavior classifications and are not post-attributed.
Posts, subscriber Communities and members-only perks differ in origin, eligibility and permitted audience.
Membership sign-ups, cancellations, membership access and payment renewals have distinct clocks.
A count of payment transactions does not count unique payers or prove repeated purchases by the same cohort.
Never claim causal retention benefit from coincident posting and audience change without identification and controls.
Never collect or commit individual membership exports, account identifiers or private analytics without consent.
